title: Prediction and results table
subject: Science
source: Written for science/y6 lesson 24 (Prediction and results table (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 24: Why objects look coloured. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To find out why objects look coloured
equipment: Coloured sweet wrappers or cellophane (red, green, blue)
Coloured objects (a red apple, a green leaf, white paper)
safety: An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: In a dark room, cover the torch with red cellophane; never shine into eyes
Predict, then shine it on each object
Record the colour each one looks
Explain using the words reflect and absorb

questions.q: Big question: what colour is a strawberry in blue light?
questions.a: Black, because it absorbs blue and has no red light to reflect.
